LESSON: CONSTRUCTING MOIST BED GARDEN

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Production Techniques
Topic 4.2: Constructing Moist Bed Garden

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Constructing Moist Bed Garden. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Moist Bed Garden
2. Practise Constructing Moist Bed Garden at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Moist Bed Garden

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Moist Bed Garden
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Constructing Moist Bed Garden. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Constructing Moist Bed Garden at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Constructing Moist Bed Garden at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Moist Bed Garden
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Moist Bed Garden. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Constructing Moist Bed Garden using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Constructing Moist Bed Garden in the examples.
2. Explain Constructing Moist Bed Garden to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Constructing Moist Bed Garden.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Constructing Moist Bed Garden using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Constructing Moist Bed Garden important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Constructing Moist Bed Garden
2. Practise Constructing Moist Bed Garden at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Constructing Moist Bed Garden

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
